evidence: junk_imagery: hook@0.3–seg0:end: a flock of hens pecks in the foreground of a brain-myth scene, and at seg1:start–seg1:end a red/white national flag, a city skyline and gold bullion bars surround the balance scale. Kit props unrelated to the brain topic.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg1:start shows a balance tilted under '96%' with gold bars, a red/white striped national flag and a city skyline. By seg1:mid it has flipped to a level '50%' with matching gold stacks while Data stands to the right and gestures.
weakest_scene.root_cause: A stock balance-scale machine with set-dressing reused from unrelated stories (flag, bullion, skyline). The brain is dropped on as an icon, and Data is not the cause of the tilt.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Redraw it as a brain-made balance: language-region tissue piled on the left hemisphere tips it to 96%, then personality traits spread evenly level it. Data loads the tissue onto the pan himself. Remove the flag, gold bars and skyline; use a neutral lab setting.
